title: Konrad-Zuse-Straße, Böblingen
description:

🌟 Apartment Features
Discover a thoughtfully designed living space perfect for professionals or couples. This medium-sized apartment seamlessly integrates living, working, cooking, and dining areas into an open-plan layout. The sleeping area is elegantly separated, ensuring privacy and comfort. Premium furnishings include designer pieces from Vitra, Muuto, and Hay, paired with customized fittings for a touch of elegance. Relax with modern entertainment amenities like a swiveling smart TV, sound box, and high-speed WiFi. 🌐📺

The bedroom includes a 160 cm Möller Design bed, complete with its own TV. Stylish decor and modern lighting create a welcoming atmosphere, while practical amenities such as a fully equipped designer kitchen, dishwasher, and espresso machine make everyday life convenient.

For shopping enthusiasts, the Mercaden shopping mall is directly opposite the apartment.

Car owners will appreciate the direct parking under the building, assigned to your apartment. Elevators and shared facilities, such as washing machines and dryers, enhance your stay.
📌 Additional Notes
Please note: A surcharge of 150 € applies per additional adult per month. The photos and floor plans are for illustrative purposes only.

title: Wilhelmstraße, Böblingen
description:
Charming studio apartment of approx. 19 m2 – ideal for solo travelers, but also suitable for two people, especially for short stays. A fully equipped kitchenette, a dedicated workspace, and a comfortable double bed (140x200 cm) ensure a pleasant and relaxing stay.

Welcome to BRERA Böblingen – Sindelfingen.
Here, you’ll find a stylish temporary home right in the heart of the city.
Plenty of space to breathe, work, and feel at ease.

Here’s what awaits you:

✨ Flexible digital check-in
📶 High-speed Wi-Fi included
🚭 Non-smoking apartment
📺 43-inch TV with national & international channels
🛏️ Comfortable double bed (140x200 cm)
🛁 Bed linen, towels, hairdryer, as well as shower gel & shampoo for the first few days
🧼 Weekly cleaning service including linen change
🧺 Laundry room with WeWash system for self-service
🛋️ Access to the "Salone" – our shared space for working and relaxing

Perfect for short stays or longer business trips! 

📍 Central location: Public transport, supermarkets, and restaurants – all just around the corner
🚆 Great connections: Quick access to Messe Stuttgart, the airport, and nearby companies
🅿️ Parking: Available on-site (subject to availability) or easily across the street at the shopping center – open 24/7 and only a few steps away
🛏️ Need an extra bed or baby cot? Just let us know a few days in advance.
🐾 Pets are generally not allowed. For exceptions, please contact us in advance. Service dogs are of course always welcome.

🌍 You can also find BRERA in: Frankfurt | Munich | Nuremberg | Ulm | Stuttgart | Leipzig | Singen
